story.originalTitle: Meet Tiffany and Aaron, F1 fans who are bringing Austin together through Matcha. Mori Matcha was born from a desire to bring Austin a feeling. More pr...
story.summaryEn:
Meet Tiffany and Aaron, F1 fans who are bringing Austin together through Matcha.
Mori Matcha was born from a desire to bring Austin a feeling. More present and more connected.
This week, we’re joining their community to celebrate race week their way.
detailZh:
遇见蒂芙尼和艾伦，两位F1车迷，他们通过抹茶将奥斯汀的人们聚集在一起。
Mori Matcha的诞生源于将奥斯汀带进一种感觉。更加当下，更加紧密相连。
本周，我们将加入他们的社区，以他们自己的方式庆祝赛车周。
detailEn:
Meet Tiffany and Aaron, F1 fans who are bringing Austin together through Matcha.
Mori Matcha was born from a desire to bring Austin a feeling. More present and more connected.
This week, we’re joining their community to celebrate race week their way.
